$comment: Agent profile (agentConfig): config/agents/*.json, Lab configurations and the start command. go/contract.ParseProfile is the one validator, used by the coordinator and the executor; it refuses unknown keys and checks the per-harness rules this subset cannot say. See contracts/README.md for the supported keyword subset.

effort.$comment: Codex only (required there); null or absent for the other harnesses.

instructionRole.$comment: codex: developer (or absent); claude: system; antigravity and acp: user.

mcpServers.$comment: Unique named MCP selections with explicit tool allowlists; legacy design-rules data retained.

tools.$comment: Claude only: absent preserves ordinary native tools; an explicit list restricts them.

delegationProfiles.$comment: At most 8 profile ids this profile may delegate to.

codeMode.$comment: add: a code server bridges the Fleet tools and connections beside them; only: instead of them (docs/designs/fleet-code-mode.md).

imageGeneration.$comment: Codex only: true turns on Codex's built-in image generation, which draws on the run's ChatGPT subscription; absent or false keeps it off.

gitNetwork.$comment: The agent may use the network for git.

publishing.$comment: The agent publishes to the project's forge (project-publishing: publish_draft, request_merge). Its runs in a project with execution.forge, pipeline steps included, need a forge login; a pipeline step of a profile without it never publishes. Absent: false.

purpose.$comment: Short one-line summary shown in the Agent Library.

category.$comment: Agent Library category (coding, research, review, operations, design, lab).

monogram.$comment: Optional 1-4 character monogram for card avatars.

variantOf.$comment: Base profile id when created as a Lab variant.

experiment.$comment: Lab experiment id that created this variant.

harnessCandidate.$comment: Host qualification of a proposed CLI pin (docs/designs/fleet-host-updates.md, step 4): the Lab override candidate puts it here; the executor stages and runs it instead of its release's pin.

id.$comment: Named host MCP binding or design-rules; no executable or environment values.

data.$comment: Legacy design-rules experiment data, otherwise only tools: explicit unique tool names.
